name: Harshitha
text: Absolutely blown away! Rahul transformed my hair completely. The balayage looks stunning and the salon has such a premium, relaxing atmosphere. I've never felt more beautiful walking out of a salon. Will definitely be back every month!

name: Nahul
text: Best grooming experience of my life! The Royal Grooming Package is worth every rupee. The facial was incredibly relaxing and the haircut was exactly what I envisioned. The staff is professional, courteous, and highly skilled.

name: Kethzial
text: I trusted them with my bridal look and they delivered magic! My bridal makeup was flawless — lasted the entire day, perfect for every photo. The whole team was so caring and patient. Poongothai Family Salon truly deserves their name!

name: Ashwini
text: I came in with damaged, over-processed hair and left with the most healthy, shiny, gorgeous hair I've had in years. The Botox treatment is miraculous. The salon is so clean and luxurious — feels like a 5-star spa!

name: Nikilesh
text: Visited for a skin fade and the result exceeded all expectations. The barber had incredible attention to detail — sharpest lines I've ever had. I've tried many salons in the city but Poongothai Family Salon is in a class of its own.

name: Ananya Singh
text: The Queen's Glow Package is an absolute steal for the services included. My skin is glowing, nails are perfect, and the hair spa made such a difference. The team was friendly and professional throughout. Highly recommend!

name: Vikram Nair
text: Great experience overall! The pompadour cut was styled perfectly and the head massage was incredibly relaxing. The salon atmosphere is very premium. Slight wait during peak hours but totally worth it for the quality of service.

name: Meera Joshi
text: Came in for the wolf cut I'd seen trending everywhere and the stylist absolutely nailed it. She understood exactly what I wanted just from the reference photo. Such talented artists here. My friends can't stop complimenting my hair!
